_comment: CampusPilot — Deterministic Demo Scenario. This file defines exactly one student persona and the minimal set of campus items required to demonstrate all 7 demo scenes. All items use the existing CampusItem schema from src/domain/campus-item/types.ts. Do NOT add fields not present in CampusItem.

scenario.name: Angel — Primary Demo Persona
scenario.description: 3-minute hackathon demo. Student interests: Technical, Cultural, Sports. Demonstrates: personalization, urgency, institutional integrity, explainability, plan creation, conflict detection.

student.name: Angel
student._note: selectedCategories must not include 'important_campus' — that is always delivered regardless.

campusItems._demoScene: Scene 2 (Don't Miss), Scene 3 (For You), Scene 4 (Explainability), Scene 5 (My Plan)
campusItems._purpose: High-urgency technical event. Registration deadline is tonight. Triggers Don't Miss section and demonstrates explainable 94% match.
campusItems.title: Campus AI & Robotics Hackathon 2026
campusItems.description: 36-hour flagship hackathon building intelligent agents, embedded robotics, and generative AI solutions. Mentorship from leading tech founders and prize pool.
campusItems.organizer: Google Developer Student Club & Robotics Society

campusItems._demoScene: Scene 3 (For You), Scene 5 (My Plan), Scene 6 (Conflict — overlaps with Wellness at 16:30)
campusItems._purpose: Cultural event in student's interests. On Oct 19, 16:30-19:00 — creates time conflict with Wellness session (16:00-17:30).
campusItems.title: Nukkad Natak Street Play Championship
campusItems.description: Impactful street plays tackling burning social and environmental issues across major university quadrangles.

campusItems._purpose: Sports event in student's interests. Demonstrates sports category match in For You section.
campusItems.title: Inter-Department Basketball Championship Semifinals
campusItems.description: High-octane knockout clash between CSE Knights and ECE Titans. Come cheer for your department from the bleachers!

campusItems._purpose: Critical MST announcement. Demonstrates institutional integrity rule — appears in Important Campus regardless of selected interests.
campusItems.title: Mid-Semester Examination (MST) Official Datesheet Released
campusItems.description: Official schedule for Odd Semester Mid-Term Examinations (October 2026). Please check your department-specific seating plans and hall ticket requirements on the student portal.
campusItems.organizer: Office of the Controller of Examinations

campusItems._demoScene: Scene 3 (Explore Something New), Scene 5 (My Plan), Scene 6 (Conflict — overlaps with Nukkad Natak at 16:30)
campusItems._purpose: Wellness item OUTSIDE student's selected interests. Appears in Explore Something New (serendipity). On Oct 19, 16:00-17:30 — creates time conflict with Nukkad Natak (16:30-19:00). Demonstrates conflict detection.
campusItems.title: Mindfulness & Stress Management for Midterms
campusItems.description: Learn practical breathwork, focus techniques, and exam anxiety management guided by certified psychologists from the counseling center.

campusItems._demoScene: Scene 3 (For You — Acoustic Open Mic as Cultural match)
campusItems._purpose: Cultural music event matching student's Cultural interest. Appears in For You with match explanation.
campusItems.title: Acoustic Night & Open Mic Under the Stars
campusItems.description: Showcase your musical talents, poetry, and stand-up performances under the campus amphitheatre stars with fairy lights and warm chai.

conflictPairs._note: This pair demonstrates Scene 6. Both events are on Oct 19. They overlap: 16:00-17:30 and 16:30-19:00.

recommendationExpectations._note: Important Campus items bypass scoring. They are never ranked by interest. They always appear in Section 3.
Wellness is outside student's selected interests. Should appear in Explore Something New, not For You.

demoPlanItems._note: These are the items to add to My Plan during the demo in order
